mapper.select: SELECT session_id AS sessionId, member_id AS memberId, goods_id AS goodsId, sales_id AS salesId, status, expire_at AS expireAt FROM tb_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_at > NOW()

SELECT d.seat_id AS seatId, d.seat_grade AS seatGrade, d.floor AS floor, d.row_no AS rowNo, d.seat_no AS seatNo, p.price AS price, h.hold_expire_at AS holdExpireAt FROM tb_seat_hold h INNER JOIN tb_goods_seatassign_details d ON d.seat_id = h.seat_id LEFT JOIN tb_goods_salesprice p ON p.sales_id = h.sales_id AND p.seat_grade = d.seat_grade WHERE h.session_id = #{sessionId} AND h.sales_id = #{salesId} AND h.seat_id = #{seatId} AND h.status = 'HOLD' AND h.hold_expire_at > NOW()
SELECT sales_id AS salesId, goods_id AS goodsId, DATE_FORMAT(play_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS playDt, play_tm AS playTm FROM tb_goods_sales WHERE sales_id = #{salesId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_cart_master SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_cart_master ( member_id, session_id, goods_id, sales_id, ticket_cnt, total_amt, status, expire_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{sessionId}, #{goodsId}, #{salesId}, #{ticketCnt}, #{totalAmt}, #{status}, #{expireAt} )

INSERT INTO tb_cart_ticket ( ticket_no, cart_id, seat_id, seat_grade, floor, row_no, seat_no, price ) VALUES ( #{ticketNo}, #{cartId}, #{seatId}, #{seatGrade}, #{floor}, #{rowNo}, #{seatNo}, #{price} )
